=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "when a failed read (the issue's state, or another linked PR) keeps the heal from running on an issue that still counts as merged, the wave is not read as complete that cycle (MERGED_HEAL_WAVE_HOLD, MERGED_STATE_WAVE_HOLD), so it cannot advance past the issue before the heal runs"
  expected_change_site: refresh_validation_dispatch_wave_gate() in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, around the validation-dispatch path's check-wave-status call (per the cross-pollination: dispatch_validation_if_needed() at lines 11824-11839 and 19027-19030).
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The LAST RUN's commit 51a732e added the wave_hold override to the main check-wave-status (lines 20315-20325) and the review-blocked handler (lines 22096-22105), but did not add the wave_hold check to the validation-dispatch path. The cross-pollination from openai_gpt-6-luna flagged this as a MAJOR finding (confidence 5): "A project already in validating can recompute its gate, accept the stale terminal status or label as WAVE_COMPLETE=true, and dispatch validation. That path continues before reaching the current-wave healer, so the stale state can persist through validation and project completion." The validation-dispatch gate computes its own WAVE_COMPLETE that's not overridden by the wave_hold, so a pending heal does not prevent a stale validation dispatch.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
